answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 94 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 13 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 94 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 554 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the karst here is verification, the willow of cost is what stops the farm, and the ocean of the record keeps every claim checkable.
